metadata.title: Galexi
metadata.description: A secure, focused workspace for building your vocabulary.

home.heading: Keep new words in orbit.
home.description: A calm, secure place to collect vocabulary, study pronunciation, and remember words through examples.
home.secureDescription: Administrators maintain the dictionary while every learner can study published words.
home.wordsDescription: Study pronunciations, Thai meanings, example sentences, and useful image links.
home.languageDescription: Built with internationalization from the start, with English enabled today.
